content: Hi, this is Spark from Smart Chip Tree. We provide employee ID card and RFID solutions, and we're currently offering free on-site service for ID card printers, card designing and software. Could I have just a brief moment of your time?

I’m calling from Smart Chip Tree – offices in Delhi, Noida, Bangalore and Pune, HQ in Delhi. We specialize in employee ID solutions. Are you currently evaluating options for your company’s identification needs?
We are already using zebra printers right now.

That’s great! We have strong partnerships with Zebra and other leading printer manufacturers. Would you like me to connect you with a specialist who can discuss your specific requirements for PVC and RFID card printing, alongside any integration needs you might have?

I understand your question. We offer a comprehensive range of ID card printers, including those compatible with Zebra systems. Our specialists can discuss wholesale rates for printer ribbons – specifically for Zebra, Evolis, HID Fargo, DataCard and IDP retransfer printers. Would you like me to connect you with a specialist?
Great. May I get your name?
Thanks. And which organization are you calling from?
Got it. What time would you prefer for the callback?
Perfect, My name is ABC., our specialist will contact you at 6 PM. Thank you for your time, have a great day!
